prompt:

Header text verbatim: "verklighet". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "reality".
Scene: An adult proudly standing outside her newly opened small bakery, faded thought bubble above showing her earlier dream of the same bakery, no readable shop sign.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "verklighet = reality; picture a dream made real.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Drömmen blir verklighet.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
